rules: ALL rules start with: some attestation in input.attestations
NEVER reuse 'result' variable - reserved for deny output
Use descriptive variable names for loops (task_result, r, step, material, subject, etc.)

top_level_001.natural_language: Verify the attestation statement has the correct _type field.

subject_003.natural_language: Verify the attestation has at least one subject image.

subject_004.natural_language: Verify all subject images in the attestation have a name.

subject_005.natural_language: Verify all subject images in the attestation have a digest.

subject_006.natural_language: Verify all subject images in the attestation have a SHA256 digest.

subject_007.natural_language: Verify the attestation has a subject image with name containing 'quay.io'.

metadata_008.natural_language: Verify the build finished timestamp exists in the attestation metadata.

metadata_009.natural_language: Verify the build started timestamp exists in the attestation metadata.

metadata_010.natural_language: Verify the build finished after it started.
metadata_010.rego_code:
deny contains result if {
    some attestation in input.attestations
    started := time.parse_rfc3339_ns(attestation.statement.predicate.metadata.buildStartedOn)
    finished := time.parse_rfc3339_ns(attestation.statement.predicate.metadata.buildFinishedOn)
    finished <= started
    result := "Build finished before or at the same time as it started"
}

metadata_012.natural_language: Verify the build completeness indicates environment is complete.

metadata_014.natural_language: Verify the build completeness indicates parameters are complete.

materials_016.natural_language: Verify the attestation has a materials section.

materials_017.natural_language: Verify the attestation has at least one material.

materials_018.natural_language: Verify all materials in the attestation have a URI.

materials_019.natural_language: Verify all materials in the attestation have a digest.

materials_020.natural_language: Verify all materials in the attestation have a SHA256 digest.

materials_021.natural_language: Verify all materials with SHA1 digest have a git URI.
materials_021.rego_code:
deny contains result if {
    some attestation in input.attestations
    some material in attestation.statement.predicate.materials
    material.digest.sha1
    not startswith(material.uri, "git+")
    result := sprintf("Material with SHA1 digest has non-git URI: %s", [material.uri])
}

materials_022.natural_language: Verify all materials with SHA1 digest have valid 40-character hex format.
materials_022.rego_code:
deny contains result if {
    some attestation in input.attestations
    some material in attestation.statement.predicate.materials
    commit := material.digest.sha1
    commit
    not regex.match(`^[a-f0-9]{40}$`, commit)
    result := sprintf("Material SHA1 digest %s is not valid format", [commit])
}

task_023.rego_code:
deny contains result if {
    some attestation in input.attestations
    some task in attestation.statement.predicate.buildConfig.tasks
    task.name == "build"
    not task.invocation.configSource.entryPoint
    result := "Build task configSource does not have entryPoint"
}

slsa_v1_035.natural_language: Verify the attestation has buildDefinition with buildType 'https://tekton.dev/chains/v2/slsa-tekton'.
slsa_v1_035.rego_code:
deny contains result if {
    some attestation in input.attestations
    attestation.statement.predicateType == "https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1"
    build_type := attestation.statement.predicate.buildDefinition.buildType
    build_type != "https://tekton.dev/chains/v2/slsa-tekton"
    result := sprintf("Attestation has incorrect buildType: %s", [build_type])
}

compound_054.rego_code:

    some attestation in input.attestations

    task.status == "Succeeded"
    count(task.results) == 0
    result := sprintf("Task %s succeeded but has no results", [task.name])
}

    bundle
    not contains(bundle, "@sha256:")
    not contains(bundle, "@sha1:")
    result := sprintf("Task %s bundle %s does not have digest", [task.name, bundle])
}

deny contains result if {

    task.status

}

    result := sprintf("Subject image name %s does not appear to be a valid image reference", [name])
